name: io.github.itsoumya-d/autopilot-fde
description: Forward-deployed engineering copilot: mines business workflows from Slack/WhatsApp streams, scores automation potential (APS) via graph entropy, Monte-Carlo-simulates ROI, and deploys human-gated LangGraph agents. Read-only discovery tools are open; mutating deploy/approve tools are operator-gated.

streamable-http.note: Served by the FastAPI app (uvicorn backend.main:app); hosted demo available as a Hugging Face Space.
